newsitem.title: USA: Health Risk sees $400,000 charge in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Health Risk sees $400,000 charge in Q3.

text.p: Health Risk Management Inc said it has incurred costs on its terminated merger with HealthPlan Services Corp and expects to report a charge of about $400,000 for those costs in its third quarter ended March 31.
The health plan management concern said it expects to add about $3 million of "new incremental revenue (net of any terminated business) in the first half of calendar year 1997."
It said it expects $3 to $4 million of "new incremental revenue in the second half of calendar year 1997 because of new contracts, expansion of existing contracts and prospects."
Health Risk said Friday that its merger with HealthPlan Services had been called off by mutual agreement.
The companies said they agreed to continue a marketing agreement and HealthPlan agreed to buy 200,000 unregistered common shares of Health Risk for $2.5 million.
Health Risk chief executive Dr. Gary McIlroy said the company is hiring and will experience some additional costs until staff productivity meets HRM standards.

"This could cause our cost of service as a percent of revenue to increase slightly during this time rather than continue to decrease slightly," McIlroy said, adding, "HRM's prospects for new business remain strong."
